Bold text overlays the center of the frame. (3) Health Point 1: The woman, wearing a beige sleeveless top, addresses the camera directly in a studio setting, holding up one finger. This is followed by a shot of her sleeping peacefully in a brightly lit bedroom. (4) Career Context: Clips show her wearing a pink dress and gray blazer at a busy public event, then walking through a hallway in an ornate floral ballgown. A camera monitor view shows her being interviewed. (5) Health Point 2: Back in the studio, she holds up two fingers. A cut shows her in a floral dress dancing in a green park, then smiling near a grand piano in a brightly lit room. (6) Point 3 & Food: She holds up three fingers. Close-up shots show a healthy salad with shrimp and chicken. She is seen eating the salad with a fork. (7) Product Intro: Icons of a chicken and a fish appear on screen as she compares supplements. She then unboxes a large orange gift box from 'Fang Zih', revealing several packets and a ceramic bowl. (9) Performance Montage: The woman is shown on a large concert stage holding a microphone, then performing at a grand piano with an orchestra in the background. (10) Conclusion: Returning to the studio view, she holds the product packet and points to promotional text with a discount code. The video concludes with a brand logo animation on a white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Intro: A female voice begins with a bright, high-arousal tone and clear articulation. The BGM is an upbeat acoustic folk track with rhythmic guitar strumming and a steady kick drum beat. (2) Mid-section: The narrator's speech rate remains fast and energetic as she lists health tips. Intermittent 'ding' and 'swoosh' sound effects emphasize text transitions. A subtle room tone is present during the talking head segments. (3) Product Demo: The speaker's volume increases as she introduces the fish essence. A clear 'pour' SFX with a splashing texture is heard as she demonstrates the liquid. (4) Social Montage: Background sounds of female laughter and group chatter fade in briefly during the living room scene. The BGM continues consistently throughout. (5) Outro: The speaker delivers a call to action with a friendly, authoritative tone. The music swells slightly and then fades out, followed by a final brand stinger SFX over the logo.
